uncertainties.note: Unnamed pilot in Berkt's unit (first appears 06753). She is never named in this slice; "she/her" is used only because her lines carry strong feminine sentence-final particles (わね/のよ), not because of any name - flagging in case an orchestrator prefers neutral phrasing instead.

"Kusakabe has no virtue!" is read as a jab at locked character Haruki Kusakabe (leader of the Martian Successors / former Jovian Federation), echoing a classical-sounding condemnation-of-a-tyrant phrasing in the source. Identity link is contextual, not explicit in this row.
Speaker of the surrender demand to "former Jovian soldiers" is not tagged; presumed to continue Tsukiomi's earlier appeal (06686) by parallel phrasing, not confirmed.

"A-class Jumper" and "Nergal Dock" are new terms without a dedicated prior glossary entry (A-class jumper only appears lower-case inside a character bio); proposed in batch_06683_glossary_proposals.json.
"a new order" (新たなる秩序) is Neo Zeon's ideological slogan running through 06691-06695; no prior lock found in the corpus, proposed as "New Order" in the glossary proposals file for future consistency.
